newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni to lose monopoly in Italian Po valley.
newsitem.headline: Eni to lose monopoly in Italian Po valley.

text.p: Italian energy group Eni will lose a 43-year monopoly on research and exploitation in the northern Po Valley from next year, when the area will be open to all oil, gas and petroleum companies under a decree approved by the government on Friday.
"The opening up of the area will, however, guarantee that rights belonging to Eni are safeguarded," an Industry Ministry statement said.
The decree law means Eni will be allowed to continue its current activities but new companies will be allowed to enter the market to find and exploit new deposits.

The decree also provides for equality of treatment for public and private operators and between operators across the country. It also aims to encourage other groups already present in Italy to develop joint-ventures.

"The new measures should contribute to the relaunch of a sector which is already showing some signs of recovery after a fall in investments over the past few years, as well as attract new foreign petroleum companies to Italy" the statement said.
